**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select "no improvement".**

The greeting card (also reducing) the need to sit down and write loving messages to our dear ones.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Has also reduced'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct structure to be used is *had/has + verb in past participle*.
 
• Let us see some examples to understand:
 
 
• *I had cooked some food for you.*
 
• *They had bought a new car.*
 
• *This has given me a new opportunity.*
 
 
 
• *Has* is used in the present tense and *had *in the past tense.
 
• The sentence in the question is discussing one of the advantageous features of writing a greeting card. This is valid in the present time. So, we will use *has.* The past participle form of the verb *reduce *is *reduced*.
 
• Correct sentence__ - *The greeting card **has also reduced** the need to sit down and write loving messages to our dear ones.*

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

questions.question: **shelf, now __________ official iceberg**
questions.solution:
‘A’/ ‘An’ are articles having the same meaning used for singular nouns. We use ‘a’ in front of consonant sounds and ‘an’ before vowel sounds.

 In English alphabets, A ,E, I, O and U are vowels and the rest are consonants. Thus, we have : a girl, a boy, an apple, an orange etc.

In the given sentence, *official* starts with a vowel sound. So, the most appropriate article would be *an* (*shelf, now **an** official iceberg*…)

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect Speech. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct Speech.**

“My hour has come.” thought the king.

options.text: The king thought that his hour had come.
His hour had come thought the king.
The king thought that his hour had came.
The king wondered if his hour has come.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The king thought that his hour had come.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In Direct speech, the message is conveyed in the words of the author or concerned person.
 
• In Indirect speech, the message is conveyed in our words. 
 
• When we convert Direct speech to Indirect speech, we omit the inverted commas. Also, the conjunction *that *is added before introducing the words spoken between quotation marks (“…”).
 
• Some notable changes that are made while doing the conversion from Direct to Indirect is :
 
 
• am --> was
 
• is --> was
 
• has --> had
 
• have been to --> had been to
 
 
 
• So, *has* in the given sentence of the question should be converted to *had*.

***So the correct sentence is-** The king thought that his hour had come.*

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.**

The fans invited the cricketer.

options.text: The cricketer was invited by the fans.
The cricketer received an invitation by the fans.
The cricketer is invited by the fans.
The cricketer was invite by the fans.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'The cricketer was invited by the fans.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When the subject performs the action – it is Active Voice.
 
• When the subject is being acted upon by the verb – it is Passive Voice.
 
• We should change the sequence of the subject and the object (or the action) while keeping the meaning intact.
 
• In Active voice – Subject + verb + object is the sequence.
 
• In Passive voice – Object + verb + Subject is the sequence.
 
• (Subject is someone that works on the object)
 
• In the given sentence, 'the fans' is the subject because they are doing an action. They are inviting. The action is done on the object which is the cricketer here. So, the sentence in the question is in its Active Voice.

To change it into passive voice, the sentence should begin with the object ‘The cricketer’.

 
• Verbs are also changed. Some conversions are :
 
 
• Eats --> is eaten
 
• Is cleaning --> is being cleaned
 
• Will clean --> will be cleaned
 
• Destroyed --> was destroyed
 
 

**Following these thumb rules, the same sentence in the passive voice is ***The cricketer was invited by the fans.*

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

The excessive use of pesticides (1)/ has negatively (2)/ effected soil output. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
The error lies in part 3 of the sentence. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

Let us understand the meanings of the words *affect *and *effect.*

The word *affect* is used as a verb only. We can use *effect* as both verb and noun.

**Affect **means to influence something or someone. **Effect**, when used as a noun, means the result of an influence. When used as a verb, effect means to bring about or cause something to occur.

Examples –

*The harmful effects of a bad company should be highlighted among teenagers. (effect as noun)*

*The bad company has affected him severely.*

*The government was not able to effect any social change. (effect as a verb - meaning the government was not able to bring about any social change)*

In the given sentence, *affected *should replace the word *effected* to make the sentence grammatically correct.

__Correct Sentence__ - The excessive use of pesticides has negatively affected soil output.

questions.question: In which of the following countries fascism did originate?
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Fascism is a form of radical authoritarian nationalism that came to prominence in early 20th-century Europe, characterized by one-party totalitarian regimes run by charismatic dictators, glorification of violence, and racist ideology.
 
• The term "fascism" was invented by the Italian Fascist dictator Benito Mussolini (1883 - 1945) and the self-described "philosopher of Fascism" Giovanni Gentile (1875 - 1944).
 
• The Great Depression, which caused significant social unrest throughout the world, led to a major surge of fascism.
 
• Fascism was also popular during the Depression-era outside of Europe, in Japan, Brazil, and Argentina among other nations.
 
• The term originated in Italy and is derived from fascio, meaning a bundle of rods, and is used to symbolize strength through unity: a single rod is easily broken, while the bundle is difficult to break.
 
• After the end of World War I, fascism rose out of relative obscurity into international prominence, with fascist regimes forming most notably in Italy, Germany, and Japan, the three of which would be allied in World War II.​

questions.question: What is the duration of the world’s shortest X-ray laser successfully created by the scientists?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__43 attoseconds__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Scientists from Zurich, Switzerland successfully created the world’s shortest X-ray laser pulse which has a duration of 43 attoseconds.
 
• With the help of this, the researchers can now observe the electron movement in high detail and understand fully the dynamics during a chemical reaction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen__ discovered X-Rays in 1895.
 
• He discovered this while working with a cathode-ray tube in his laboratory.
 
• X-Ray is an electromagnetic wave of high energy and very short wavelength, which is able to pass through many materials opaque to light.
 
• The frequency of X-Rays is 1016 to 1019 Hz.
 
• X-rays are used to detect cracks in bones, in medicine and industries and also for security purposes.
 
• Soft and Hard X-rays
 
 
• X-rays are usually described by their maximum energy, which is determined by the voltage between the electrodes.
 
• X-rays with high photon energies (above 5–10 keV) are called hard X-rays.
 
• Due to their penetrating ability, hard X-rays are widely used to image the inside of visually opaque objects.
 
• Those with lower energy (and longer wavelength) are called soft X-rays.
